functions.name: entry
functions.summary: Entry point: parses config/sound-driver setup, calibrates joystick, saves interrupt vectors + installs custom timer, reads N interrupt vectors per hardware mode (6 Tandy / 12 CGA), builds the row-offset table, sets video mode, plays the intro sequence, tears down on exit.

functions.name: App_PlayIntroSequence
functions.summary: Top-level intro sequence orchestrator: cycles through the draw-slot/bounce-animation helpers across DAT_1000_0648 states 0/1/2, framed by Video_ClearFramebuffer and Video_FadeOutPalette.

functions.name: Video_WaitVsyncAndCountFrame
functions.summary: Polls port 0x3DA (vertical retrace bit) for a full inactive->active transition, then increments the frame counter at [8a3a]. Matches GAMEU.EXE's identical function.

functions.name: Snd_SelectDriverScriptTable
functions.summary: Reads sound-driver selector char [8cef] (A/R/S/B/T) and sets [0xbaef] to that driver's fixed timing-script table address; far-calls the driver init entrypoint for A/R/T.

functions.name: Gfx_ConvertLogoResourceBank
functions.summary: Sets [8cb9]=0x12fd then calls Gfx_ConvertResourceEntry for a batch of fixed resource-table offsets -- converts a bank of logo sprite/palette resources to the active hardware's pixel format.

functions.name: Video_ClearFramebuffer
functions.summary: Dispatches by hardware mode: CGA/Tandy = flat word-fill; EGA/VGA = programs Sequencer/GC registers then clears via a loop.

functions.name: Gfx_LoadFrameRowTable
functions.summary: Loads a 16-word row-offset table for frame index AL into [0x8b2b], stores AL into [8c51], then calls Video_PrepareFrameHardware.

functions.name: Anim_RunTimedSequence
functions.summary: Walks the per-sound-driver timing-script cursor at [0xbaef], drawing frames for a duration derived from the script byte; bails early if the abort flag [8b9c] is set.

functions.name: Gfx_LoadFrameRowTableTandy
functions.summary: Tandy-specific sibling of Gfx_LoadFrameRowTable: looks up [8aa2] from a fixed table indexed by (AX-0x22), then blits.

functions.name: Gfx_AnimateBounceCycle
functions.summary: Ping-pong bounce animation: draws frames 0->17 then 17->7, waiting for vsync each step. Dispatches to Gfx_SwapPageBuffersTandy on Tandy.

functions.name: Gfx_AnimateToFrame
functions.summary: Draws frames until reaching frame index BX, waiting for vsync each step. Dispatches to Gfx_SwapPageBuffersTandy on Tandy.

functions.name: Gfx_SwapPageBuffersTandy
functions.summary: Tandy double-buffer page swap: two 16KB block copies between segment 0 and [0x8a40], separated by 4x Gfx_OrMaskBlitTandy calls; gated on DAT_1000_0648.

functions.name: Gfx_OrMaskBlitTandy
functions.summary: Masked OR-blit: ORs a fixed lookup table ANDed with AH into 100 rows x 0x50 bytes with 0x4000 bank-wrap, then waits for frame counter==1.

functions.name: Gfx_AnimateToFrameOrClear
functions.summary: Dispatch: EGA/VGA loops drawing frames until BX; Tandy waits 1 vsync; CGA calls Gfx_AndMaskFramebufferRegion x4.

functions.name: Gfx_AndMaskFramebufferRegion
functions.summary: ANDs AX into 200 rows x 0x28 words with 0x4000 bank-wrap (CGA framebuffer clear-via-mask), then waits for frame counter==1.

functions.name: Video_FadeOutPalette
functions.summary: Fade-to-black effect: 8 steps, each decrementing 15 palette entries via Video_DecrementPaletteEntry and waiting 2 vsyncs.

functions.name: Video_DecrementPaletteEntry
functions.summary: Decrements each of a packed palette word's 3 RGB nibble fields by 1 if nonzero -- the fade-step primitive for Video_FadeOutPalette.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawFrameFromSlot3A
functions.summary: Sets [8aa2]=[0x36] and blits -- one of three byte-identical duplicate compiled bodies (08d8/0914/0959).

functions.name: Gfx_DrawFrameFromSlot3B
functions.summary: Byte-identical duplicate of Gfx_DrawFrameFromSlot3A.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawFrameFromSlot3C
functions.summary: Byte-identical duplicate of Gfx_DrawFrameFromSlot3A.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawFrameFromSlot3Quad
functions.summary: Draws the [0x36] frame slot 4 times in a row.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawFrameFromSlot0
functions.summary: Sets [8aa2]=[0x2c] and blits (draws whichever frame pointer slot 0 currently holds).

functions.name: Gfx_SetRowStrideConstantsForMode
functions.summary: Sets 5 fixed row-pitch/count constants at [0xc53]-[0xc5b] per hardware mode -- geometry parameters for the slot-sequence blit helpers.

functions.name: Gfx_AnimateSlot2Sequence
functions.summary: Draws the [0x30] frame slot repeatedly, after setting mode-dependent stride constants via Gfx_SetRowStrideConstantsForMode.

functions.name: Gfx_AnimateSlot4Sequence
functions.summary: Sibling of Gfx_AnimateSlot2Sequence for the [0x32] frame slot.

functions.name: Gfx_AnimateSlot5Sequence
functions.summary: Sibling of Gfx_AnimateSlot2Sequence for the [0x34] frame slot (no BP stride constant).

functions.name: Gfx_AnimateSlot1Sequence
functions.summary: Sibling of Gfx_AnimateSlot2Sequence for the [0x2e] frame slot.

functions.name: App_WaitFramesOrAbort
functions.summary: Advances the script cursor, waits for vsync/frame-count target; if the abort flag [8ba1] is set, runs the full teardown sequence and returns early.

functions.name: App_PerformExitSequence
functions.summary: Unconditional teardown: clears screen, redraws slot3+bounce frames, resets script cursor, restores state, stops sound, waits vsync, frees environment blocks if set.

functions.name: Gfx_ConvertResourceEntry
functions.summary: Converts one logo/palette resource to the active hardware's pixel format: EGA calls Gfx_BlitPlanarResourceEga; CGA builds packed RGBI nibbles; Tandy calls Gfx_PackTandyPixelNibble in a loop.

functions.name: Gfx_PackTandyPixelNibble
functions.summary: Bit-packing primitive: folds 4 registers' sign bits into a nibble via an XOR-keyed lookup -- structurally identical to GAMEU.EXE's AltBuild_Pack*FromSignBits family.

functions.name: Gfx_BlitPlanarResourceEga
functions.summary: EGA planar copy: cycles Sequencer Map Mask through 0x1,0x2,0x4,0x8 copying one word per plane per iteration, then resets Map Mask to 0xf.

functions.name: Video_ResetGraphicsControllerEga
functions.summary: Resets Sequencer Map Mask and Graphics Controller registers to their default read/write-mode-0 state.

functions.name: Load_PackedFileWithRetry
functions.summary: DOS file load with retry: opens/reads the file named at [8cb9], depacks via Rnc_Depack if the RNC magic is present; retries on error. Matches GAMEU.EXE's Load_PackedFile.

functions.name: Video_CallInt10h
functions.summary: Trivial INT 10h (video BIOS) call wrapper.

functions.name: Dos_PrintString
functions.summary: Prints a NUL-terminated string at BX one character at a time via INT 21h.

functions.name: Sys_NoOpStub
functions.summary: Empty stub -- always returns immediately.

functions.name: Gfx_BlitFrameToFramebuffer
functions.summary: The core frame-draw primitive: copies the current source frame into the framebuffer via the row-offset table at [0xb95d] (EGA/CGA) or a fixed stride copy (Tandy).

functions.name: Video_ExpandPaletteTable
functions.summary: Rebuilds the 0x1e0-entry palette table at [0xbc9e] from RGBI component lookups -- matches GAMEU.EXE's Video_ExpandPaletteFadeTable.

functions.name: Video_SetMode
functions.summary: Video driver dispatch on [8a9e] (E/i/C/T/4/0/default): sets page segment pointers, programs CRTC offset register 0x13=0x16 (352px virtual width), dispatches to Video_SetModeCga/Tandy paths.

functions.name: Video_FillFramebufferWords
functions.summary: Fills 0x4000 words (32KB) with AX -- flat framebuffer clear for CGA/Tandy.

functions.name: Video_SetModeCga
functions.summary: Sets DAT_1000_2b2a=0xffff (CGA mode marker), calls INT10h x2 if needed, sets B800 page segments.

functions.name: Video_SetVgaPaletteA
functions.summary: Programs VGA-style palette registers (port 0x3c2=0x4b, Sequencer setup, CRTC index 0xe/0x11 sequence) writing a variable-length palette buffer.

functions.name: Video_SetVgaPaletteB
functions.summary: Sibling of Video_SetVgaPaletteA using port 0x3c2=0x66 instead of 0x4b.

functions.name: Video_FlipAndSync
functions.summary: Double-buffer page-flip dispatch across Tandy/EGA/CGA; waits on DAT_1000_28b4 then optionally services the sound driver via a far call.

functions.name: Video_PrepareFrameHardware
functions.summary: Per-hardware frame-prep dispatch: CGA scales/loads a palette + INT10h; EGA calls Video_ApplyPaletteEga; Tandy programs port 0x3da/0x3de per output color.

functions.name: Video_ApplyPaletteEga
functions.summary: Builds a 16-byte palette buffer then applies it with INT10h -- matches GAMEU.EXE's Video_ApplyVgaPalette.

functions.name: Sys_NoOpStub2
functions.summary: Empty stub, sibling of Sys_NoOpStub.

functions.name: Video_ScaleColorComponent
functions.summary: Scales a 0-7 EGA color component to a 6-bit VGA DAC value -- byte-for-byte matches GAMEU.EXE's Video_ScaleColorComponent.

functions.name: Input_CalibrateJoystick
functions.summary: Joystick calibration entry point -- matches GAMEU.EXE's Input_CalibrateJoystick: computes axis center/range constants.

functions.name: Input_MeasureJoystickTiming
functions.summary: Measures joystick RC-timing loop count, stores it into DAT_1000_1f53.

functions.name: Input_PollJoystickEdge
functions.summary: Waits for a joystick-port bit set then clear transition.

functions.name: Input_WaitJoystickBitSet
functions.summary: Busy-waits on port 0x3DA bit 3 per detected polarity.

functions.name: Input_WaitJoystickBitClear
functions.summary: Inverse-polarity sibling of Input_WaitJoystickBitSet.

functions.name: Input_DetectJoystickPolarity
functions.summary: Times two vsync-bit half-cycles and compares durations to determine port 0x3DA's active polarity.

functions.name: Input_ReadJoystickPortRaw
functions.summary: Raw joystick port (0x201) read plus a vsync-port touch, used by the RC-timing loop.

functions.name: Input_ReadJoystickState
functions.summary: Per-frame joystick/abort-state read: fires the one-shot, times RC discharge, writes direction/button byte to [8ba1] (abort flag) and [8cd3].

functions.name: Input_ComputeJoystickButtonMask
functions.summary: Combines button-state words into the packed byte pair at [8cd5]/[8cd4].

functions.name: Sys_SaveInterruptVectors
functions.summary: Installs the custom timer then, if not already saved, saves two interrupt vectors via INT21h AH=35h.

functions.name: App_HandleFatalStartupError
functions.summary: Fatal-startup teardown, called from entry when Config_ParseIniAndLoadSoundDriver returns <0.

functions.name: App_HandleAbortResumePrompt
functions.summary: Abort/Resume scancode prompt loop -- 0x1e ('A') tears down and returns; 0x13 ('R') re-sets video mode and resumes. Same scancode pair as GAMEU.EXE's App_ExitOrReset.

functions.name: App_HandleFatalStartupErrorB
functions.summary: Byte-identical duplicate of App_HandleFatalStartupError, called from entry's other failure branches.

functions.name: Sys_RestoreState
functions.summary: Shared cleanup helper: stops sound, waits vsync, restores timer, restores saved interrupt vectors -- matches GAMEU.EXE's Sys_RestoreState.

functions.name: Config_ParseIniAndLoadSoundDriver
functions.summary: Main init: parses config text (video driver char, joystick mode, 5 key-bindings into a 512-byte lookup table), dispatches sound-driver loading per letter, far-calls the driver entrypoint.

functions.name: Config_SkipLine
functions.summary: Line-oriented text scanner: advances to just past the next LF, or stops on NUL. Matches GAMEU.EXE's Config_SkipLine.

functions.name: Snd_StopDriver
functions.summary: Stops/resets the active sound driver: 'T'/'B' write a stop pattern then far-call the entrypoint; 'A'/'R'/'S' just far-call it.

functions.name: Sys_InstallCustomTimerHandler
functions.summary: Reprograms PIT channel 0 and installs a custom timer interrupt vector, saving the original -- matches GAMEU.EXE's Sys_InstallCustomTimerHandler.

functions.name: Sys_RestoreOriginalTimerHandler
functions.summary: Restores the saved timer vector and resets PIT channel 0 to the BIOS default divisor.

functions.name: Gfx_BuildRowOffsetTable4000
functions.summary: Builds a 200-entry framebuffer row-offset table with +0x2000 bank-interleave wrapping at the 0x4000 boundary.

functions.name: Gfx_BuildRowOffsetTable8000
functions.summary: Sibling of Gfx_BuildRowOffsetTable4000 wrapping at the 0x8000 boundary instead.

functions.name: Rnc_Depack
functions.summary: The RNC ProPack-1 depacker: validates the magic, builds a Huffman table per chunk, decodes via Rnc_HuffmanLookup/Rnc_ReadBits. Matches GAMEU.EXE's FUN_1000_fcc4 depacker.

functions.name: Rnc_ReadHeaderWord
functions.summary: Calls Rnc_ReadBigEndianWord (redundant intermediate call) -- reads one big-endian header word.

functions.name: Rnc_ReadBigEndianWord
functions.summary: Byte-swaps a little-endian word into big-endian -- reads RNC header fields. Matches GAMEU.EXE's Sys_ReadByteSwappedWord.

functions.name: Rnc_ComputeParagraphCount
functions.summary: Converts a byte count to a paragraph (16-byte) count, rounding up on a nonzero remainder.

functions.name: Rnc_HuffmanLookup
functions.summary: Walks the Huffman decode table matching the current bit-window against each entry, consuming bits via Rnc_ReadBits.

functions.name: Rnc_ReadBits
functions.summary: RNC bit-stream reader: extracts bits from the rolling 32-bit window, refilling from the input stream when it underflows.

functions.name: Rnc_BuildHuffmanTable
functions.summary: Canonical-Huffman decode-table builder from a list of code bit-lengths, consumed by Rnc_HuffmanLookup.
